sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 34080 of 2024
Applicant :- Har Prasad

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Omar Zamin,Sudhanshu Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Omar Zamin, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.
2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 251 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 506, 120B IPC, Police Station Lodha, District Aligarh during pendency of the trial.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that FIR of the present case was lodged by the real uncle of the applicant with the allegation that applicant also sold the share of his property but entire allegation leveled against the applicant is totally false and actually applicant sold the share of his own property.
He further submits that even present dispute appears to be civil dispute.

4. He further submits that along with applicant his brother Manoj Kumar was also made accused but after considering the entire facts of the case, he has been released on bail by this Court vide order dated 24.07.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 26830 of 2024.

sentences.text: He further submits that all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate and applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 13.05.2024.
6. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Considering the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant and the fact that similarly placed co-accused Manoj Kumar, the brother of the applicant has already been released on bail by this Court and applicant is not having any criminal history and all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 13.05.2024, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant - Har Prasad be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
